newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says good prospects for inflation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says good prospects for inflation.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday prospects were good for low inflation after data showed the consumer price index fell 0.2 percent in the June quarter.

The figures released earlier on Wednesday also showed that underlying inflation rose 0.3 percent in the quarter for a year-on-year rate of 1.7 percent, the lowest annual underlying inflation rate since the series started in 1971.
The annual CPI was a rise of just 0.3 percent, the lowest annual rate since the December quarter of 1992.
"We now have a better inflation outlook and a good interest rate outlook but I'm not going to give revised 97/98 budget forecasts until we do our mid-year review," Costello told reporters.
Official cash interest rates are currently at 5.5 percent after having been cut four times in the past year.
